pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on: Respect? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: Respect with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hadith on: Respect has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hadith on: Respect to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on: Respect.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Honesty? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Honesty.
   B. Use Hadith on:Honesty to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on:Honesty has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Honesty with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Selected surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected surah.
   B. Say Selected surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Selected surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

6. Which response best shows understanding of Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Say Environment has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Environment to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment.
   D. Apply the teaching of Environment with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Believe in? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Believe in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Believe in has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Believe in to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Believe in.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Early life of the prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Early life of the prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Early life of the prophet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Early life of the prophet has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Early life of the prophet.

10. Which response best shows understanding of care for plants? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing care for plants.
   B. Apply the teaching of care for plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use care for plants to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say care for plants has no place in daily life.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain care for plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on: Respect with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. D — Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Honesty with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. C — Apply the teaching of Selected surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

6. D — Apply the teaching of Environment with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A — Apply the teaching of Believe in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Apply the teaching of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Apply the teaching of Early life of the prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. B — Apply the teaching of care for plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

12. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Environment; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of care for plants; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
